text: Getting started with Retivo, locally. Four quick steps.
Install, copy the settings file, start the emulators, and run the app.
Step two: sign in. A dev account is already filled in.
Then set up encryption, using the same password.
Step three: save your recovery key.
It's the only way back in if you forget your password. Nobody can recover it for you.
Copy it, store it somewhere safe, tick the box, and continue.
Step four: load the demo data.
It's a ready-made sample household, with accounts, balances, income, expenses, and scenarios.
That's it. You're in. Take the tour in the user guide.
